description: Wave-1 rehearsal reference data (ETL-0, migrations/load_reference_data.py). A clean fix_migration install has res.company, operating unit OU1 and the fix.role catalogue but no legal entity, brands or device models; this fixture supplies the rows no legacy extract carries. Operating units are resolved from branches_extract.json (created only when named in `operating_units`); brands and device models are derived from devices_extract.json (a brand needs its code in `brand_codes`). The entity's company is the target's single res.company and its operating unit is `entity.operating_unit_code` - no fallback ids, no invented names or codes. Synthetic, DE-12 safe.
